interpretation_label: Excluded entirely (no CD covariate in the model at all)
tested_by_candidates: M0 (no-covariate variant), M1, M2, M3, M4 (all run once with CD term removed as a null comparator)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: If the true generative process has no CD dependence, a CD-0 model should recover its remaining parameters (baseline rate, excitation) cleanly and should not show spurious CD-coefficient significance (since there is no CD coefficient to test) -- this is the null/simplicity baseline every other interpretation is compared against.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: A CD-0 model achieves comparable or better AIC/BIC/WAIC than CD-1 or CD-2 variants on synthetic data actually generated without true CD dependence; if CD-0 also does comparably well on data generated with true CD-1 or CD-2 dependence baked in, that would indicate the CD variable is not identifiable from this data at all regardless of its true role.
root_causes_addressed: #5 (source-observation confounding, tested by omission); #10 (identifiability, as a comparator)

interpretation_label: Event-intensity covariate (V1's assumption): x_CD(t) directly modulates the TRUE latent event rate
tested_by_candidates: M0 (as a GLM predictor, not offset), M1 (as already implemented, unchanged), M2, M3, M4
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: Under CD-1, higher CD_t genuinely means more historical events occurred that year, independent of documentation practices. A correctly-specified CD-1 estimator should recover theta1 with the same good calibration V1 already showed for theta0/theta1 (94-99% CI coverage, postmortem section 5) when CD-1 is the true generating mechanism.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: Synthetic data generated under a true CD-1 mechanism (CD_t enters the intensity function directly, exactly as simulate.py already implements) is recovered with well-calibrated theta1 estimates AND the excitation parameters (alpha/beta or n/beta) are NOT biased by the presence of the CD-1 covariate -- a stronger identifiability test than V1's existing theta1-alpha correlation check alone.
root_causes_addressed: #5 (this interpretation is exactly what Phase B flagged as confounded with source concentration); #10
decision_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- V1 already implicitly assumed this without testing the alternative

interpretation_label: Observation/exposure covariate: x_CD(t) modulates the PROBABILITY OF OBSERVING an event that occurs at a constant true underlying rate
tested_by_candidates: M0 (as a GLM offset term), M2, M3, M4 (all require a new source-observation thinning stage, Simulation Spec Stage 2, not yet implemented)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: Under CD-2, the true event rate is constant (or follows its own independent dynamics) and CD_t instead governs detection/recording probability -- structurally an exposure/offset term, not a rate predictor. A correctly-specified CD-2 estimator should recover the true constant rate cleanly once the exposure adjustment is applied.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: Synthetic data generated under a true CD-2 (exposure-thinning) mechanism recovers the true underlying constant rate accurately only when the estimator applies the CD-2 exposure correction; a CD-1-specified estimator run on CD-2-generated data should show a characteristic bias pattern (mistaking detection-probability variation for rate variation) -- observing that exact bias pattern in a synthetic cross-check is itself confirmatory evidence for CD-2 as the correct real-world interpretation.
root_causes_addressed: #5 (this is the interpretation that would resolve Phase B's confound, if correct); #3 (wrong variable selection, if V1 assumed CD-1 when CD-2 was correct all along)
decision_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- new Stage-2 thinning code required before this can be tested at all

interpretation_label: Treated as exact continuous timestamp (V1's current assumption for all 141 events via jitter_ties fabrication)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: If forced to consume interval-censored ground truth without fabrication, M1's estimator either requires re-introducing a jitter/fabrication step (confirming the architecture cannot consume the data's true resolution) or fails to fit at all.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: M1 recovers acceptably only when its own jitter-fabrication step is present; recovery quality degrades or the estimator cannot run at all when fabrication is removed and true interval data is supplied directly -- this would confirm root causes #3/#4 are structural to M1's architecture, not merely a bug fixable within the same model class.

interpretation_label: Treated as an interval-censoring window at the true archival resolution (year-level for the majority of the corpus)
tested_by_candidates: M0, M2, M3 (all natively interval/bin-based, no fabrication needed by construction)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: Candidates natively designed for censored/binned data should recover cleanly under the real corpus's actual mixed-precision regime without requiring any fabricated sub-year ordering.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: M2 (MBPP) in particular recovers alpha/beta/branching-ratio with bias and CI-coverage comparable to V1's own theta0/theta1 calibration (94-99%), when tested under the real precision-mixture distribution (Design doc section 3) rather than V1's continuous-time-only synthetic regime.
root_causes_addressed: #3; #4; #11 (this is the interpretation the audit's corrected conclusion endorses)

interpretation_label: Treated as a genuinely exact point (true for the precision-verified subset only)
tested_by_candidates: M4 (by construction, only on the filtered precise subset)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: On the subset where sub-year precision genuinely exists in the source (first-pass estimate: 75/141 = 53% single-exact-day, pending a dedicated parsing audit), a continuous-time Hawkes formulation is legitimately applicable without fabrication.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: M4 recovers cleanly on the precise subset even though the full-corpus M1 benchmark does not on the full corpus -- this specific contrast (M4 passes where M1-on-full-data fails) would be the single strongest confirmation that resolution mismatch, not the Hawkes family itself, was the dominant driver of V1's original failure.
root_causes_addressed: #4; #11 (isolated from confound with sample size, since M4 uses a real, not synthetic, subset boundary)
decision_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- depends on Phase 0 precision-parsing audit confirming subset size

interpretation_label: Flat, independent events (V1's implicit assumption -- no parent/child modeling anywhere in likelihood.py)
tested_by_candidates: M0, M1, M2 (as currently scoped), M4
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: Apparent clustering recovered by the excitation term may in fact be absorbing within-episode dependence rather than genuine between-episode contagion.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: Recovery quality (branching-ratio bias specifically) degrades measurably when synthetic data is generated with episode structure (Simulation Spec Stage 5) but fitted with a flat/independent-events estimator, relative to when synthetic data is genuinely flat -- directly reproducing Phase D's Sas-expedition finding (47.2% of 90-day pairs from one episode) as a controlled synthetic test rather than an observational post-hoc finding.
decision_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- new episode-structured generator required (Simulation Spec Stage 5, not yet implemented)

interpretation_label: Episode-aware (parent-child structure explicitly modeled or conditioned on)
tested_by_candidates: M3 (natural extension point per Design doc section 1, not implemented in this tournament's first pass -- noted as a future extension, not scoped as a mandatory candidate variant)
expected_behavior_under_this_interpretat: An episode-aware discrete-time formulation with episode-level random effects should show materially better branching-ratio recovery than the flat STRUCTURE-A comparator when the true generative process has genuine episode clustering.
recovery_result_that_would_confirm_this_: Episode-aware M3 variant (if built as a future extension) recovers branching ratio with less bias than flat M3 on episode-structured synthetic data.
root_causes_addressed: #6 (a stronger test than STRUCTURE-A's negative/degradation-only evidence)
decision_status: NOT_YET_RUN -- explicitly out of this tournament's first-pass scope per Design doc section 1 (M3 description)
